items.text: Scott Alan Meyers is an attorney and small business owner. He says he has practiced civil law for 37 years and has been a member of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles for 26 years. He was a proponent of the Nithya Raman recall effort.

sentences.text: Scott Alan Meyers is an attorney and small business owner.
He says he has practiced civil law for 37 years and has been a member of the Consumer Attorneys Association of Los Angeles for 26 years.
He was a proponent of the Nithya Raman recall effort.

items.text: His campaign centers on affordability, border security, taxpayer accountability, education reform, and reviving the motion picture industry. He aims to reduce federal spending to fight inflation, lower taxes, cut regulatory barriers for housing and small businesses, and support American energy independence. He also calls for strong border enforcement against drug trafficking and transparency for California’s high-speed rail and homelessness spending. He advocates for schools that prepare students for independence.
